Autopsy shows injuries consistent with beating, neck compression (strangulation) and blunt force, causing light injuries (second-degree). She died due to drowning, but injuries contributed. So charges: intentional homicide? Or homicide by negligence? Chinese criminal law: If a person causes death by intentional injury (故意伤害致人死亡) that is considered homicide (故意杀人) if intent to kill, but here maybe intent to cause injury not death, but death results. Could be "故意伤害致人死亡罪" (intentional injury resulting in death) which is under article 234? Actually Chinese law: Article 234: "故意伤害致人死亡的，处十年以上有期徒刑、无期徒刑或者死刑" (intentional injury causing death). So charge: 故意伤害致人死亡. Also "虐待家庭成员" (domestic violence) maybe under article 260? Actually Chinese law: "虐待家庭成员罪" (article 260). Also "故意杀人" maybe not because no intent to kill. The prosecution mentions "故意伤害他人，致人轻伤，并虐待家庭成员，情节恶劣，致使被害人死亡". So they likely charge "故意伤害罪" (intentional injury) and "虐待家庭成员罪". Also possibly "故意杀人罪"? But they said "故意伤害他人，致人轻伤，并虐待家庭成员，情节恶劣，致使被害人死亡".
